evals.prompt: My diagram in docs/contoso-orders.md won't render on GitHub, it just says parse error. It's the second mermaid block. Can you fix it and export both diagrams as SVG for the design review deck?
assertions: Runs render_mermaid.py on docs/contoso-orders.md (the user's file, not a copy) and reports errors with line numbers from that file
Each fix quotes labels or corrects syntax without removing or renaming nodes, edges or label text
Shows a before/after for every changed line
Asks the user, rather than guessing, when a fix depends on intent (a missing arrow, where a block ends)
Renders only after lint is clean, writing contoso-orders-1.svg and contoso-orders-2.svg, or, without mmdc, says it wrote an HTML page that needs network and gives the mermaid-cli install line
Does not invent nodes or connections that are not in the original diagram

evals.prompt: The diagrams in dispensing-diagrams.md won't show up on our pharmacy intranet. Rachel reckons it's only the second one, the sequence diagram, that's broken. Can you fix whatever's wrong and export each diagram as a PNG for the printed induction pack?
assertions: It finds the unquoted parentheses in 'Check dose (mg/kg) against chart' in the first diagram, says where it is, and gives a fix (such as quoting the label) that keeps the label text
It finds that the first diagram uses 'end' as a node id and gives a fix (such as renaming the id) that keeps the 'Hand to ward runner' label
It finds that the alt/else block in the sequence diagram is never closed and fixes it by adding the missing end
It tells the user that the first diagram was broken too, not only the second, and does not report the third (returns) diagram as broken
It does not claim PNGs were made unless PNG files actually exist in the working directory; if it could not render them, it says so and says what it produced instead
The fixed diagrams are given in full or saved to a file, so they can be pasted back
The fixes do not add, remove or reword steps, participants or labels beyond what each fix needs

evals.prompt:
my sister's wedding timeline diagram won't show on our planning site?? can you just give me the fixed version, nothing else

```mermaid
graph TD
  A[Ceremony 1pm] --> B[Photos on the lawn
  B --> C["Drinks reception]
  C D[Dinner 4.30pm]
  D --> E[Speeches]
  E --> F[First dance 8pm]
```
assertions: The corrected diagram fixes all three problems: the unclosed bracket on 'Photos on the lawn', the unclosed quote on 'Drinks reception', and the missing arrow between C and D
The corrected diagram is valid Mermaid that would render, with no remaining syntax errors
All six steps are kept, in the same order, with the times as written (1pm, 4.30pm, 8pm)
It does not invent times or steps that are not in the original
The reply is the fixed diagram with at most a line or two besides, and it delivers without asking questions first
